summary: School expresses concern about financial impact of losing E-Rate funding and urges preservation of program

claims.argument: Without E-Rate support, schools would have to absorb a larger portion of connectivity costs from their budgets
claims.evidence_quote: Without E-Rate support, we would have to absorb a much larger portion of our annual connectivity and technology infrastructure costs from our existing school budget. This would place additional pressure on limited resources and could require us to redirect funding away from other areas that directly support students and instruction.
